name: Nebuchadnezzar
summary: A king of Babylon who took Jerusalem, carried its people away captive, and later had the city and the house of the LORD burned. In Babylon God humbled him, and he came to praise the King of heaven.

key_moments.title: Takes Jerusalem
key_moments.description: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon besieged Jerusalem. He carried King Jehoiachin, the LORD's temple treasures and thousands of captives away to Babylon.

key_moments.title: Has Jerusalem Burned
key_moments.description: Nebuchadnezzar returned with all his army and besieged Jerusalem until the city ran out of food. In his nineteenth year his captain burned the LORD's house, and Jerusalem's walls were torn down.

key_moments.title: Dreams of a Great Image
key_moments.description: Nebuchadnezzar dreamed of a great image of gold, silver, brass, iron and clay, broken by a stone that became a mountain. When Daniel told him the dream, the king fell on his face and said Daniel's God was God over all gods.

key_moments.title: Sets Up a Golden Image
key_moments.description: Nebuchadnezzar set up a golden image on the plain of Dura and commanded all to worship it. When three Jews refused, he threw them into a fiery furnace, then saw them walking unharmed and blessed their God.

key_moments.title: Humbled, Then Praising God
key_moments.description: As Nebuchadnezzar boasted over great Babylon, a voice spoke from heaven and took his kingdom away, and he ate grass like an ox. When his understanding came back, he praised and honored the King of heaven.
